sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view across an enormous vertical shaft lined with a stacked city, seen from a terrace on one side, the far wall clearly divided into different quarters: on the left hanging gardens spilling green vines and trees over the terraces' edges with waterfalls; in the middle a sheer cliff where little flying cabs are parked in holes in the wall like birds in a cliff, with workshops, cranes and ladders; on the right a quarter of great bronze bells hung out over the void on long wooden beams under small pagoda roofs; below them a market of balconies built out on stilts and cables; a tall spire with rings in the middle of the shaft, a turquoise acid lake glowing far below. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack leans on a railing in the foreground, for scale. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, pink and cream walls, garden greens, bronze, turquoise depths, sky blue, violet shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
